_note: Batch H: 6492 Lipo-B MIC injections, 7656 allergy testing. The Lipo-B set keeps the post's honesty intact: the 'what it is not' card and the FDA self-injection warning are both carded, so a reader who only sees the graphics does not come away with a fat-burning claim.

cards.subject: Lipo-B
cards.heading: What Are Lipo-B (MIC) Injections, Really?
title: What Is in a
Lipo-B
(MIC) Injection
cards.alt: A Lipo-B MIC injection holds methionine, inositol and choline, usually with B vitamins including B12

items.label: Methionine
items.note: Amino acid in methylation and fat metabolism

items.label: Choline
items.note: Helps the liver package and move fats

items.label: B vitamins
items.note: Usually B12, for energy and nerve function

cards.subject: Lipo-B
cards.heading: What Lipo-B (MIC) Injections Are Not
title: What
Lipo-B
Is and Is Not
cards.alt: Lipo-B is nutrient support inside a supervised plan, not an FDA-approved weight-loss drug or a fat-melting shot

good.heading: What it is
items: Nutrient support for liver and energy
A tool inside a supervised plan

bad.heading: What it is not
items: A fat-melting shot on its own

cards.subject: Lipo-B
cards.heading: Who Should Be Cautious or Avoid MIC/Lipo-B?
title: Who Should Be Cautious With
Lipo-B
cards.alt: Take extra care with Lipo-B if you have heart, liver or kidney disease, a psychiatric history, or ingredient allergies

items.label: Heart or vascular disease
items.note: Choline intake is a specific concern

items.label: Ingredient allergies
items.note: To any component of the injection

cards.subject: Lipo-B
cards.heading: Beware of Unapproved "Fat-Dissolving" Injections Online
cards.alt: The FDA warns unapproved fat-dissolving injections have caused infections, scarring and tissue damage; never self-inject
cards.kicker: Lipo-B is not an online fat-dissolver
cards.headline: Never self-inject
cards.footer: Injections belong in a licensed clinic, from a reputable pharmacy

cards.subject: Lipo-B
cards.heading: What to Expect if You Start Lipo-B Injections
title: Starting
Lipo-B
Injections
cards.alt: Starting Lipo-B: a consultation with labs and other options, an intramuscular injection visit, then tracked follow-up

steps.label: Consultation
steps.note: History, labs, and the other options discussed

steps.label: Injection visit
steps.note: Intramuscular, arm or hip, often weekly

steps.label: Follow-up
steps.note: Weight, energy, side effects, adjust or stop

cards.subject: allergy test
cards.heading: The Different Types of Allergy Tests
title: The Three Types of
Allergy Test
cards.alt: Three allergy tests: skin prick in 15 to 20 minutes, a blood IgE test in days, and a 48-hour patch test

rows.label: How it works
values: A drop of allergen, then a tiny prick
A blood sample measured for IgE antibodies
Allergen patches worn on the skin

rows.label: Used for
values: When a lab measurement is preferred

cards.subject: allergy test
cards.heading: Preparing for Your Allergy Test Appointment
title: Preparing for an
Allergy Test
cards.alt: Before an allergy test: tell your doctor about antihistamines, avoid named foods if tested, and wear short sleeves

items.label: Medications
items.note: Antihistamines can interfere, tell your doctor

items.label: Food tests
items.note: You may be asked to avoid certain foods first

items.label: Short sleeves
items.note: Makes a skin test far easier

cards.subject: allergy
cards.heading: Treatment Options Post-Test
title: Treatment After an
Allergy
Test
cards.alt: Allergy treatment after testing: medications, immunotherapy shots for severe cases, and targeted avoidance

items.label: Allergy shots
items.note: Immunotherapy, for severe or stubborn cases

items.label: Avoidance
items.note: The most effective treatment there is

cards.subject: allergy testing
cards.heading: Common Misconceptions About Allergy Testing
title: Allergy Testing
Myths and Facts
cards.alt: Allergy testing myths: that it hurts, that only food causes allergies, and that testing is only for severe reactions

good.heading: Fact
items: A mild sting, over in minutes
Pollen, dander, mold, dust mites and stings
Mild symptoms are worth testing too

bad.heading: Myth
items: You can only be allergic to food
Testing is only for severe reactions
